description:
Decide and document the two open design questions in the epic description before further work.

**Q1 — Session handoff.** Subscriber path lets a new LV pid reclaim an existing subscription via `Subscriber.session_token`. Pick:
  (a) Add a callback to `Filament.Cell` (e.g. `claim/3`) so every transport implements handoff; OR
  (b) Push handoff entirely into the LV adapter — web-side code maintains a (subscriber-tuple ↔ session-token) mapping and calls `subscribe`/`unsubscribe` itself; Cell stays oblivious.

Default lean: (b). Justification: not every backend reconnects (a TUI process either runs or doesn't), so pushing it up keeps the abstraction minimal and doesn't tax future transports.

**Q2 — Hook name.** Once `use_observable` is deleted, do we keep the new hook as `use_cell` or rename it to `use_observable`? Default lean: rename to `use_observable`. 'Cell' is internal jargon (the behaviour module stays `Filament.Cell`); consumers shouldn't have to learn it.

Output: a short note in the epic comments capturing the decision and rationale; this unblocks T5–T8.
title: Resolve design Q1 (handoff) and Q2 (naming)
